sources.title: README.md · swiss-ai/Apertus-v1.5-8B at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Summary Apertus 1.5 is a family of 8B and 70B parameter language models designed to advance the state of multilingual, multimodal, fully open, and transparent AI. The models support a wide range of languages, handle contexts of up to 262,144 tokens, and it uses only fully open training data whilst delivering performance comparable to other models of similar size.

sources.title: Apertus AI
sources.snippet: Apertus 1.5 is a continued pretraining of Apertus 1.0: we added 4 trillion tokens of text and multimodal training data to the 8B model and 2 trillion tokens to the 70B model. As with every Apertus release, the models are fully open: open weights, open data, open values, and full training details.

sources.snippet: This page provides a high-level technical overview of the Apertus 1.5 model release. Apertus 1.5 represents a significant architectural evolution over the initial release, moving toward a multimodal-first training paradigm while expanding the regulatory compliance framework to five core documents.
